question: Which of the following books did the famous cricketer Sunil Gavaskar author?

options.text: Democracy’s XI: The Great Indian Cricket Story

solution:
The correct answer is __**Runs 'n Ruins**__

__
 
• **Runs 'n Ruins is the book authored by famous cricketer Sunil Gavaskar**__.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
 

 Book
 **Author**
 
 

 Democracy’s XI: The Great Indian Cricket Story
 
 
 
• Rajdeep Sardesai is the author of the book.
 
• It narrates **post-independence** cricket.
 
 
 
 

 Playing It My Way
 
 
 
• It is the autobiography of Sachin Tendulkar.
 
• It entered the** Limca Book of Records** for being the best selling adult hardback across both fiction and non-fiction categories
 
 
 
 

 Runs 'n Ruins
 
 
 
• It was written in 1984.
 
• Sunil Gavaskar is a former cricketer and Indian cricket commentator.
 
• He was a recipient of **Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan **
 
 
 
 

 Captain Cool
 
 
 
• It is authored by Ezekiel Gulu.
 
• It is the story of **MS Dhoni**
